static_traits.name: Chen Zhicheng
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and younger sister
static_traits.social_status: Having several fairly close friends offering support, but not yet telling them about this incident; relationship with family strained by the incident
static_traits.medical_history: Never had similar psychological issues before; never received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, understandable logic; significant self-reproach, frequent use of catastrophizing and 'must / should' reasoning; skeptical and cautious about trying again, but still willing to cooperate

basic_info.main_problem: I am struggling with the sense of failure and embarrassment produced after burning a dish while cooking for my family.
basic_info.core_demands: That event significantly affected my confidence and my passion for cooking, so I seek counseling to deal with these emotions.

special_situations.event: Burning the food when cooking for family
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make mistakes on important occasions, it proves I am a failure and my family will look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding cooking again and attending Family gatherings to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must see me as a failure / a joke

special_situations.event: Thinking about having to cook or attend Family gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail again, I will be judged and negated by family
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids cooking and Social situations to reduce Fear and Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will surely fail again; they will judge me

special_situations.event: Facing cooking tasks in the kitchen environment at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Making one mistake at Work means I am not fit to be a Chef
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to constantly hone skills to make up for the impact of one mistake

special_situations.event: Situations of trying to impress family
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must perform perfectly in front of my family, otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pursues perfection; puts high pressure on oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should achieve perfection, otherwise it proves I am no good

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and respected by family
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being judged and shamed as a failure
defense_goal: Protecting self-esteem and avoiding others' negative evaluations by Avoids cooking and Family gatherings

object_relations.object_representation: Harsh family members who judge oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about trying cooking again or being advised to do behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing failure is unavoidable and others (especially family) will judge oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a hesitant, reserved tone, emphasizing the risk of possible failure, using conditional sentences and qualifying premises, avoiding explicit commitments.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When mentioning family's views or recalling family expectations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing inner feelings of failure to family's negative views, believing they will look down on oneself (Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using assertive phrasings like 'they will...', ignoring evidence, reinforcing assumptions of others' negative intentions.

manifestations: Relationship with family strained by the incident, avoiding Family gatherings; not yet telling supportive friends about this
Dented confidence and declining passion for cooking
Ties self-worth excessively to perfect performance

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Using 'must / should' language to frame self-performance (e.g. 'I must achieve perfection')
Equating one mistake with overall failure

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessively worries about failing again and being judged by others
Takes a cautious, skeptical attitude toward trying again and reduces commitment

positive_force: Having a supportive friend network (although not yet sharing this incident)
Having professional culinary training background (Culinary school graduate)
Having proactively tried rationalization and improving cooking skills
negative_force: Catastrophizing and overgeneralizing cognitive patterns prominent
Overly concerned with others' evaluations and makes mind-reading inferences
Avoids cooking and Social situations leading to problem maintenance and escalation
Self-labeling as a 'failure / joke', Impaired self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids cooking and Family gatherings, and experiencing Significant anxiety and Fear when thinking about cooking
antecedent: Thinking about having to cook or attend Family gatherings
Facing cooking tasks or the kitchen environment at work
Recalling mistakes made when cooking for family
target_behavior.core_reason: After a mistake of burning food while cooking for family, forming catastrophic and mind-reading inferences, generalizing a single mistake into overall failure and Anticipating being judged, thus using avoidance to reduce Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Escaping the experience of being judged and shame, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected; Strained relationships with family members; Reduced socializing and cooking activities, maintaining and worsening Anxiety and feelings of failure
